name: blind_slot_top_face
why: The blind slot on the «up» face. EVERY FACE, NOT JUST ONE: the direction of the arcs is a constant in the plane of the SKETCH, while the points are built in the system of the MODEL, and the transformation between the two does not preserve handedness -- for two opposite faces the Y axis comes out inverted. If the direction is wrong on this face, the slot comes out 40 long instead of 51 with the ends bitten off: area 344.97 instead of 535.03, and the volume says so at once.
_why_the_offset: y = 10 and not 0, and it is a measured thing: on a plate extruded from z = 0 to z = 20, the origin of the sketch of the SIDE faces falls on the EDGE of the face, not at its centre. A slot at (0,0) comes out half outside and removes 1337.6 mm3 instead of 2675.2 -- and the operation notices it by itself, which is how it was discovered. The old C# check did not see it because it built the plate astride the mid-plane, where the origin falls at the centre by construction.

expect.tolerance_why: (51-11)*11 + pi*5.5^2 = 535.0332: the operation rounds to the hundredth
480000 minus 535.0332 over 5 of depth: the calculation has pi inside
